players.product: York chillers for hyperscale data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Johnson Controls' 10-Q says AI and high-performance computing are driving increased demand for hyperscale and data center cooling solutions, a trend that has contributed to increases in its orders and backlog. Orders for the three months ended June 30, 2026 were $6.8 billion. Remaining performance obligations were $27.1 billion at June 30, 2026, approximately 68% expected to be recognized over the next two years.
quarterly_data.figure: orders $6.8 billion (three months ended June 30, 2026); RPO $27.1 billion (approximately 68% within two years)
